YOUR WIND WATCH

Tower wind alerts

Rules are saved in this browser and evaluated while this dashboard is open. Alerts use available sensors at or below your height limit, independently of map layers and displayed height. Browser suspension and data publishing can delay alerts. No email or background alerts.

Sound must be enabled each session. It plays once when a rule first meets its threshold and rearms after fresh readings fall below it.

New alert rule

Towers to monitor

Sustained uses the 1-minute mean. Both speed and height limits include equality. Sensors older than 5 minutes cannot trigger or clear an alert. Monitoring uses the latest report at each sensor height and its prevailing side when available.
DISTANCE · DETECTION · TIME

Lightning watches

Create rings around any site. A detection inside a ring starts its hold timer; each newer detection restarts it. Watches use MERLIN records independently of map layer visibility and the displayed lightning trail.

Preferences are saved in this browser.

Optional sound plays on activation and when a newer matching detection resets a hold. Enable it each session. Monitoring requires an open dashboard; browser suspension and publishing delays can delay alerts.

New lightning watch

Use a negative longitude for Florida. Tower coordinates are a starting point; adjust them for your exact site.

Radius includes detections on its boundary. Red: active hold. Amber dashed: coverage gap. Gray dashed: paused. Create another watch at the same center for additional rings. The feed retains 60 minutes, so hold times are limited to 60 minutes. “No recent detections” describes available records and does not establish a GO decision.
